scope: Full application (all authenticated admin areas and features)

suites.name: Authentication
suites.description: Admin login flow, auth guards, session management, and logout

tests.name: Admin Login Flow via WorkOS
tests.purpose: Verify admin can authenticate through WorkOS AuthKit and access admin portal
verify: WorkOS login page loads or redirect to admin dashboard
tests.notes: Full WorkOS flow requires manual interaction; use saved state for subsequent tests

tests.name: Admin Auth State Restore
tests.purpose: Verify saved admin browser state can be restored and provides access

tests.name: Admin Auth Guard - Unauthenticated Access Blocked
tests.purpose: Verify unauthenticated users cannot access admin routes
verify: Does NOT show admin dashboard content

tests.name: Admin Logout Flow
tests.purpose: Verify admin can log out and session is cleared
verify: Redirects to home page or WorkOS logout
Cannot access /admin after logout (shows auth required)

tests.name: Admin Loading State
tests.purpose: Verify loading spinner displays during auth verification
preconditions: Fresh page load with valid auth

suites.name: Navigation
suites.description: Header nav, dashboard cards, route transitions, and deep links

tests.name: Header Navigation Links
tests.purpose: Verify all header navigation links work correctly
verify: Each navigation click transitions to correct page
Page titles match expected: Employer Verification, GDPR Compliance Dashboard, Appointment Types, Admin Dashboard
URL updates correctly for each route

tests.name: Dashboard Card Navigation
tests.purpose: Verify dashboard cards navigate to correct pages

tests.name: Deep Link Access - All Admin Routes
tests.purpose: Verify all admin routes are accessible via direct URL
verify: No console errors on any page

tests.name: GDPR Dashboard Quick Actions Navigation
tests.purpose: Verify quick action links on GDPR dashboard navigate correctly

tests.name: Logo Navigation to Home
tests.purpose: Verify OccuHealth logo in header navigates to home page
verify: Clicking logo navigates to landing page (/)

suites.name: Employer Verification
suites.description: List pending employers, verify/reject workflow, and empty state

tests.name: Pending Employers List Display
tests.purpose: Verify pending employers are displayed correctly
verify: Card header shows 'Pending Verification (N)' with count
Either employer cards are displayed OR empty state message shows

tests.name: Employer Card Details
tests.purpose: Verify employer card displays all required information
preconditions: At least one pending employer exists
verify: Company registration number if available (Reg: X)

tests.name: Verify Employer Action
tests.purpose: Verify clicking Verify button approves employer
preconditions: At least one pending employer exists
verify: Employer is removed from pending list OR list count decreases

tests.name: Reject Employer Action
tests.purpose: Verify clicking Reject button rejects employer
preconditions: At least one pending employer exists
verify: Employer is removed from pending list OR list count decreases
Rejection reason is sent (hardcoded: 'Did not meet verification requirements')

tests.name: Empty State Display
tests.purpose: Verify empty state displays when no pending employers

suites.name: GDPR Dashboard
suites.description: Stats cards, consent coverage, SLA tracking, audit activity, and quick actions

tests.name: GDPR Dashboard Stats Cards Display
tests.purpose: Verify all four stats cards display correctly
verify: Each card has appropriate icon (Users, Shield, AlertTriangle, Activity)

tests.name: Consent Coverage Progress Bar
tests.purpose: Verify consent coverage section displays correctly
verify: Shows 'Patients with all required consents' label
Shows X / Y count of patients
Mentions three consent types (data processing, health data, employer sharing)

selectors.consentDescription: text:data processing, health data, employer sharing

tests.name: Erasure SLA Tracking Section
tests.purpose: Verify SLA tracking displays pending, approaching deadline, and overdue counts
verify: Erasure Request SLA Tracking card is visible
Warning badge appears if approaching deadline > 0

tests.name: Audit Log Activity Chart
tests.purpose: Verify audit activity breakdown displays last 7 days
verify: Audit Log Activity card is visible
Either action items with counts OR 'No audit activity' message
Action items show action name and count badge

selectors.emptyAuditActivity: text:No audit activity in the last 7 days

tests.name: Recent Audit Logs Section
tests.purpose: Verify recent audit logs display correctly
verify: Recent Audit Logs card is visible
Either log entries OR 'No recent activity' message
Log entries show action name and resource type

tests.name: Quick Actions Section
tests.purpose: Verify quick action links are functional

tests.name: GDPR Dashboard Data Loading
tests.purpose: Verify getGDPRStats query loads correctly
verify: Data renders in UI (not stuck on loading)

suites.name: Erasure Requests
suites.description: List pending erasure requests, process erasure, and empty state

tests.name: Erasure Requests Page Display
tests.purpose: Verify erasure requests page loads correctly
verify: Either request cards OR empty state message

tests.name: Erasure Request Card Details
tests.purpose: Verify erasure request cards display all required information
preconditions: At least one pending erasure request exists

tests.name: Process Erasure Action
tests.purpose: Verify clicking Process Erasure executes GDPR erasure workflow
preconditions: At least one pending erasure request exists
verify: Request is removed from pending list OR status changes
tests.notes: CAUTION: This is a destructive action that will permanently redact patient data. Execute only in test environment.

tests.name: Empty State Display
tests.purpose: Verify empty state displays when no pending erasure requests

suites.name: Audit Logs
suites.description: Log entries display and empty state

tests.name: Audit Logs Page Display
tests.purpose: Verify audit logs page loads correctly
verify: Either log entries OR empty state message

tests.name: Audit Log Entry Details
tests.purpose: Verify audit log entries display all required information
preconditions: At least one audit log exists
verify: Actor type displayed (employer, doctor, admin, system)
Arrow separator between actor and resource

tests.name: Audit Logs Data Loading
tests.purpose: Verify getAuditLogs query loads correctly with limit

tests.name: Empty State Display
tests.purpose: Verify empty state displays when no audit logs

suites.name: Appointment Types
suites.description: List types, add type dialog, toggle active/inactive, and empty state

tests.name: Appointment Types Page Display
tests.purpose: Verify appointment types page loads correctly
verify: All Appointment Types card is visible
Either type cards OR empty state message

tests.name: Appointment Type Card Details
tests.purpose: Verify appointment type cards display all required information
preconditions: At least one appointment type exists
verify: Status badge shows Active (green) or Inactive (gray)
Duration displayed with clock icon (N min)
Price displayed with banknote icon (£N.NN or Free)

tests.name: Add Type Dialog Opens
tests.purpose: Verify Add Type button opens the create dialog
verify: Dialog opens with title 'Add Appointment Type'
Duration input field present (number, min 15, step 15)
Price input field present (number, min 0, step 0.01)

tests.name: Create Appointment Type
tests.purpose: Verify creating a new appointment type works correctly
verify: New type appears in list (real-time update)
tests.cleanup: Delete 'Test Appointment Type' via Convex dashboard after test

tests.name: Toggle Active/Inactive Status
tests.purpose: Verify toggling appointment type active status works
preconditions: At least one appointment type exists

tests.name: Cancel Dialog Without Creating
tests.purpose: Verify Cancel button closes dialog without creating type
verify: No new type appears in list

tests.name: Empty State Display
tests.purpose: Verify empty state displays when no appointment types

tests.name: Form Validation - Required Fields
tests.purpose: Verify form prevents submission with empty required fields

tests.name: Creating State Button Disabled
tests.purpose: Verify submit button shows 'Creating...' and is disabled during mutation
tests.cleanup: Delete 'Quick Test Type' via Convex dashboard after test

suites.name: Error Handling
suites.description: Console errors, network failures, and loading states

tests.name: No Console Errors on Page Load
tests.purpose: Verify no console errors on any admin page load
verify: Warnings are acceptable but should be reviewed

tests.name: Loading State Display
tests.purpose: Verify loading spinners display while data loads

tests.name: Network Error Handling
tests.purpose: Verify graceful handling when Convex queries fail
verify: No 400 or 500 errors in network log
If errors occur, UI displays appropriate error message
tests.notes: This test validates normal operation; actual network failure testing requires mocking

tests.name: Auth Token Expiry Handling
tests.purpose: Verify admin is redirected when auth token expires
verify: Shows 'Admin Access Required' message (DB verification fails)

suites.name: UX/Completeness
suites.description: Ease of use, visual consistency, responsiveness, and improvement opportunities

tests.name: Visual Consistency - Dark Mode Support
tests.purpose: Verify admin portal supports dark mode consistently
verify: Colors adapt to dark mode (bg-slate-800, text-slate-100)

tests.name: Responsive Design - Mobile View
tests.purpose: Verify admin portal is usable on mobile devices
tests.notes: Review screenshots for mobile usability issues

tests.name: Navigation Clarity
tests.purpose: Assess clarity of navigation structure

easeOfUse: Can users find GDPR features quickly?
Is the relationship between /admin/gdpr and /admin/gdpr/erasure clear?
Is the employer verification workflow intuitive?
improvements: Consider: Active nav state highlighting
Consider: Breadcrumb navigation for GDPR sub-pages
Consider: Dashboard stats clickable to drill-down

tests.name: Feedback on Actions
tests.purpose: Verify users receive clear feedback on their actions

improvements: Consider: Add toast notifications for successful actions
Consider: Add loading spinner on buttons during mutation
Consider: Confirmation dialog for destructive actions

tests.name: Empty State Helpfulness
tests.purpose: Assess empty states provide guidance
verify: CTA to create first item is prominent
User understands what to do next

improvements: Consider: Add illustration to empty states
Consider: Add 'Get Started' guidance text
Consider: Link to documentation for setup

tests.name: GDPR SLA Urgency Indicators
tests.purpose: Assess urgency indicators are clear and actionable
verify: Quick action to process erasures is easily accessible

completeness: SLA countdown days remaining not shown on individual requests
No notification system for approaching deadlines
No export/report feature for compliance audits
improvements: Consider: Add days remaining to each erasure request
Consider: Email notifications for approaching SLA deadlines
Consider: GDPR compliance report export (CSV/PDF)

tests.name: Form Usability - Add Appointment Type
tests.purpose: Assess appointment type form usability
verify: Input types are appropriate (number for duration/price)

improvements: Consider: Add helper text for each field
Consider: Show currency symbol in price input
Consider: Duration presets (15, 30, 45, 60 min buttons)
Consider: Preview card showing how type will appear

tests.name: Audit Log Readability
tests.purpose: Assess audit logs are easily scannable and understandable

improvements: Consider: Add filter dropdown for action types
Consider: Add date range picker
Consider: Add search by actor/resource
Consider: Add pagination for large log volumes
Consider: Link resource IDs to resource details

tests.name: Employer Verification Workflow
tests.purpose: Assess employer verification workflow completeness
verify: Employer details are sufficient for verification decision

improvements: Consider: Confirmation dialog for destructive actions
Consider: Custom rejection reason text input
Consider: Tab to view verified/rejected employers
Consider: Audit trail of who verified whom

routes: All routes render content without errors
features: Employer verification workflow complete (list, verify, reject)
GDPR dashboard shows all metrics (stats, consent coverage, SLA tracking, audit activity)
Appointment type CRUD complete (list, create, toggle active)
gaps: No edit functionality for appointment types (only create + toggle)
No delete functionality for appointment types
No custom rejection reason for employers
No pagination on erasure requests (only paginated query, no UI controls)
No notification system for SLA deadlines

strengths: Clear navigation header with all main sections
Dashboard provides quick overview with links
weaknesses: No active state highlighting on current nav item
No confirmation dialogs for destructive actions
No toast notifications for action feedback

highPriority: Add confirmation dialog for Process Erasure (destructive, irreversible)
Add confirmation dialog for Reject Employer
Add custom rejection reason input field
mediumPriority: Add toast notifications for successful actions
Add days remaining to erasure request cards
Add audit log filtering by action/date

executionNotes.dataDependent: Several tests require specific data (pending employers, erasure requests, audit logs, appointment types)
executionNotes.destructive: Tests marked 'destructive' modify data - execute in test environment only
executionNotes.qualitative: Tests marked 'qualitative' require manual review of screenshots/snapshots
executionNotes.cleanup: Some tests create data that should be cleaned up after execution
